summary.title: Soham Kamani - Making a Telegram Bot (2016)
summary.one_liner: The page is Soham Kamani's blog index rather than the article itself; the listing points to his 2016 post on building a responsive Telegram bot in Node.js.
takeaways: The fetched page is a blog index listing, not the Telegram bot article body, so its text does not describe the bot's implementation.
The codecrafters build-your-own-x list links this 2016 post as 'How to make a responsive telegram bot' in Node.js.
The blog index also lists a later related post, 'Making (and deploying) an Interactive Telegram Bot in Node.js', and a Go version, 'Making an interactive Telegram bot in Go (Golang)'.
summary.summary: The fetched page text is the sidebar/index of Soham Kamani's blog, listing many posts on Go, Java, Node.js, and other topics. It does not include the body of the 2016 article at the given URL, so the specific steps and code are not visible here. The listing describes the post as a Node.js tutorial on making a responsive Telegram bot. Related Telegram bot posts appear in the index, including a Node.js deployment guide and a Go version.
